bio: Renesse is now the Knight of the Heart, defender of the vital border city of Precipice. Her duty was to use the Heart of Glass, a powerful protective relic, but the Heart was stolen on the eve of battle and the city was conquered. Now she seeks the Heart… and the thief who took it.
